evidence.quote: 总时长写成3秒，同时又要求每个分镜各自持续27秒。

This creates an impossible temporal plan with no feasible shot boundaries or duration allocation.
criteria.rationale: A 3-second total duration cannot accommodate 27-second shots. Reversing the timeline without coherent continuity or motivation further breaks temporal logic. This violates the requirement for a feasible temporal plan.

criteria.rationale: Camera specifications must be coherent and actionable. The simultaneous demand for locked and shaky shots is physically impossible and renders the visual plan infeasible.
